title: Migrate smallhold persona IDs from i64 to String (TEXT UUID)
description: The fieldwork canonical schema uses TEXT UUIDs for persona and user IDs. Smallhold's Rust code still uses i64 for account_id/persona_id everywhere (AuthenticatedAccount, PostRow, query return types). This causes runtime type mismatches. Need to change account_id: i64 → String throughout api.rs, posting.rs, interactions.rs, inbox.rs, and all other files that reference persona IDs.
close_reason: All persona/user IDs migrated from i64 to String across 12 files. Live federation test passes: auth, search, follow, post, delivery all working with TEXT UUID IDs.
